# opencode-pi

<!-- Generated by tools/gen-docs.sh from modules/components/opencode-pi; do not edit. -->

The OpenCode and Pi coding agents: both discover the shared skills in `~/.agents/skills`, and Pi reads the instance's agent rules.

The component lives in [`modules/components/opencode-pi`](../../modules/components/opencode-pi/):

- [README.md](../../modules/components/opencode-pi/README.md): what it installs, its options and its settings.
- [maintenance.md](../../modules/components/opencode-pi/maintenance.md): its pins and how `dotsteward-update` refreshes them.
- [default.nix](../../modules/components/opencode-pi/default.nix): the Home Manager module that fills the component contract.
- [seed.json](../../modules/components/opencode-pi/seed.json): the flake inputs and lock entries an instance starts with when it enables the component.

See the [catalog](../catalog.md) for the other components.
